name: agent-dashboard
description: Live dashboard pane for Claude Code (main, worker, advisor, context, files, tests, cost, limits, tools, timeline, log), plus a Haiku worker and the advisor rule

autoOpen.title: Open on session start
autoOpen.description: Open the dashboard pane when a session starts (otherwise use /dashboard)

band.title: Status band above the prompt
band.description: Show a one-line summary (phase, main, subagents, advisor, cost) above the prompt

background.title: Pane background
background.description: dark: a dark retro screen; theme: the app's own pane colour

workerModel.title: Worker model
workerModel.description: Model for Explore workers when the call names none: haiku (cheap scouting) or inherit (leave it to Claude Code)

conciseWorkers.title: Short worker reports
conciseWorkers.description: Ask Explore workers for a short report (path:line bullets, no pasted files), so less lands in the main context

advisorRule.title: Advisor rule
advisorRule.description: Add a system prompt line: consult the advisor only before a plan, after the same error twice, and before done
